    LIMIT 1
)

WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(transaction_date) AS max_dt FROM Financial_Transactions),
filtered AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', ft.transaction_date) AS yr_month,
           SUM(ft.transaction_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM Financial_Transactions ft
    JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN max_date md ON 1=1
    WHERE ft.transaction_type = 'Payment'
      AND a.account_name = 'VIP'
      AND ft.transaction_date >= date(md.max_dt, '-5 months')
    GROUP BY yr_month
),
ordered AS (
    SELECT yr_month,
           total_amount,
           LAG(total_amount) OVER (ORDER BY yr_month) AS prev_total
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT total_amount,
       CASE
           WHEN prev_total IS NULL OR prev_total = 0 THEN NULL
           ELSE ROUND((total_amount - prev_total) * 100.0 / prev_total, 2)
       END AS month_over_month_pct_change
FROM ordered
ORDER BY yr_month;
